guidance: Adult-supported, short, flexible, inclusive offline activities. No grading, diagnosis, child-data collection or forced evidence uploads.

activities.title: Conversation circle
activities.instructions: Talk together about a familiar object; wait, respond and ask an open question.
activities.evidence: Adult notes a child-initiated reply or gesture
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Story word explorer
activities.instructions: Read a picture book and explore two new words with pictures or real objects.
activities.evidence: Adult notes words understood or used in context
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Rhythm and rhyme play
activities.instructions: Sing a familiar rhyme, pause for the child to complete or gesture a phrase.
activities.evidence: Adult observes participation in any communication mode
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Make-believe story
activities.instructions: Use toys or puppets to act out a beginning, event and ending.
activities.evidence: Adult records a child contribution without correcting imagination
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Feelings with puppets
activities.instructions: Use puppets to name feelings and practise asking for help.
activities.evidence: Adult observes safe emotion expression or co-regulation
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Try-again challenge
activities.instructions: Choose a manageable construction task and celebrate trying different approaches.
activities.evidence: Adult notes effort and support offered
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Daily self-care choices
activities.instructions: Practise age-appropriate handwashing or choosing weather-appropriate clothing.
activities.evidence: Adult notes child participation, not speed or independence ranking
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Turn-taking together
activities.instructions: Play a simple cooperative game and model kind conflict resolution.
activities.evidence: Adult observes turn-taking with support
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Outdoor movement trail
activities.instructions: Move through a safe obstacle route using stepping, balancing and jumping as suitable.
activities.evidence: Adult observes movement and accessible alternatives
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Balance and space game
activities.instructions: Try reaching, stretching and moving safely around obstacles.
activities.evidence: Adult notes safe spatial awareness and confidence
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Small hands workshop
activities.instructions: Explore play dough, pegs, threading or puzzles with appropriate supervision.
activities.evidence: Adult observes grasp, coordination or adapted tool use
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Draw and make marks
activities.instructions: Experiment with chunky crayons, brushes or other accessible mark-making tools.
activities.evidence: Keep optional child-created work sample
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Choose a story
activities.instructions: Share a child-chosen book and talk about pictures, feelings and events.
activities.evidence: Adult notes understanding expressed verbally or nonverbally
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Tell it back
activities.instructions: Retell a familiar story using pictures, props or actions.
activities.evidence: Adult records one child-led retelling moment
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Sound hunt
activities.instructions: Listen for phonemes in spoken words and connect sounds to letters when ready.
activities.evidence: Adult notes sound discrimination without requiring reading fluency
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Write for a purpose
activities.instructions: Make a pretend shopping list, card or sign through marks, letters or dictated words.
activities.evidence: Keep optional work sample or adult transcription
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Count real treasures
activities.instructions: Count small safe objects and compare groups up to ten as appropriate.
activities.evidence: Adult notes one-to-one correspondence with support
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Build number groups
activities.instructions: Represent small quantities using blocks, fingers or dots.
activities.evidence: Adult notes different representations used
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Shape detectives
activities.instructions: Find and compare shapes, positions and sizes in the room or outdoors.
activities.evidence: Adult records a shape or positional word explored
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Pattern maker
activities.instructions: Make and extend simple patterns using objects, movement or sounds.
activities.evidence: Adult observes pattern exploration, not timed answers
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Neighbourhood helpers
activities.instructions: Talk about familiar community helpers and places during a walk or picture exploration.
activities.evidence: Adult records child questions or observations
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Nature detective
activities.instructions: Look closely at leaves, insects or weather safely, without collecting living animals.
activities.evidence: Adult notes a child-led observation
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Our different stories
activities.instructions: Share family traditions, languages and experiences respectfully and inclusively.
activities.evidence: Adult records a respectful question or contribution
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Wonder and investigate
activities.instructions: Use safe objects to compare floating, sinking or material textures with adult supervision.
activities.evidence: Adult notes prediction and observation
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Materials studio
activities.instructions: Create with paper, recycled materials, paint or clay using child-led choices.
activities.evidence: Keep optional child-made artwork
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Pretend-play corner
activities.instructions: Invent a shop, home, journey or fantastical scene using open-ended props.
activities.evidence: Adult observes original ideas or collaboration
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Music and movement
activities.instructions: Explore rhythm, sound and movement with voice or safe instruments.
activities.evidence: Adult notes child-led exploration
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.

activities.title: Share and appreciate
activities.instructions: Look at art, listen to music or watch a performance and respond in any accessible way.
activities.evidence: Adult notes a preference, feeling or observation
activities.accessibility: Offer spoken, visual, gesture-based and adapted-motor participation; do not require screen interaction.
